notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.Tree of Perdition has exactly thirteen toughness.
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Cast Jaya's Immolating Inferno by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 3 damage to the opponent.
Cast Hidetsugu's Second Rite by paying {3}{R}, dealing 10 damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
